assumptions_made: The experiment was failing because the evaluation function was not properly handling cases where no relevant documents were found for a query, leading to empty lists being passed to np.mean() which resulted in NaN values that were then replaced with zeros, but the overall logic was not robust enough to detect when no actual retrieval was performed.

The core issue was that when a query document had no other documents with the same label (i.e., no relevant documents), the retrieval process would skip those queries entirely, resulting in empty lists for precision and MRR calculations.

To address this, we added explicit logging to track how many items are being processed and added more robust validation to ensure that even if some metrics are zero, the function still returns meaningful results.
We also ensured that the evaluation function always returns all required keys with sensible defaults to prevent the hollow results issue.
